unknownFields: Preserved unsupported pending complete governing classification
catalogIdentity: Resolved namespace plus exact name plus native encoding, including non-applicable encoding entries; do not collapse namespace fanout by qualified SQL name
providerAdmission: Validate selected native provider/null-field grammar; libc uses collcollate/collctype and null colllocale, other providers use colllocale and null libc fields. Do not convert null to empty or derive defaults without original target context. Default provider requires complete original database-default definition. Unknown/inconsistent provider meaning remains unsupported.
additionalRequiredDefinitions: resolved namespace/owner and original dependency/comment/extension closure
selected actual provider build/library/locale/rules and independently qualified comparator profile
complete affected index/constraint dependencies and independent usability/rebuild evidence when version compatibility is uncertain
canonicalProducer: Separate declared-definition comparison from runtime comparator/environment admission. OID reassignment alone may preserve meaning; encoding, determinism, provider, locale/rules or recorded version changes remain explicit. Equal recorded version strings do not establish equal comparator behavior. NULL version means unavailable recorded information, not compatibility.
repairPolicy: Observation never executes REFRESH VERSION, REINDEX or locale repair. A refreshed version is not proof dependent objects were rebuilt.
